svg.aria-label: Periodic table of periods 1 to 6 with group numbers 1 to 18 across the top. Metals, plain, fill the left and center; nonmetals, dotted, are at the upper right plus hydrogen; metalloids, striped, form a staircase from boron to astatine: B, Si, Ge, As, Sb, Te, At. Group 1 is the alkali metals (not hydrogen), group 2 the alkaline earth metals, groups 3 to 12 the transition metals, group 17 the halogens and group 18 the noble gases. Rows are periods.
svg.text: Rows are periods. Lanthanides and actinides not shown.
